title: Exclusive: Cambridge Heavy Industries has been quietly building a desktop fusion device | TechCrunch
summary: Cambridge Heavy’s fusion reactor uses lasers to compress a fuel target, similar to the groundbreaking experiment that proved controlled fusion reactions could produce more power than they consume. Cambridge Heavy’s design generates high pressures with relatively low laser power, Kai said.
